label: IoMT HTTP Control Bridge
info: HTTP bridge for backend-issued control actions. Import this flow into Node-RED, set the MQTT broker node, then point DEVICE_CONTROL_ENDPOINT at the HTTP In endpoint.

name: Backend endpoint
info: POST JSON to /iomt/control. The flow accepts backend payloads with device_id, action, command_id, command_topic, and metadata.
